Make each day YOUR day, do what you really really want first and what you think you should do second. Take each day a picture and some notes to remember each day. With moreDays you can reflect your day in a personal journal, follow your goals, define challenges, everything is in your hand, just do it. Make every day a good day :)

Goals

What makes a good day, a balanced day? Define different goals, such as fitness, mindfull, nutrition. However, too many goals are difficult to reach. Think of goals, you want to focus on every day. If a goal is not relevant any longer or not relevant at the moment, because you are on holiday, set it to be inactive. For every goal you define how difficult it is for you, start with a low number of points and increase over time.

Activities

Activities are the options to fulfill a goal. Remember, there is always more than one way to do it. E.g. for fitness you could define activities like sports or yoga or walking. The points may mirror, how difficult it is for you or how much time it takes. Take your time to define more than one option for your goal. That\'s one of the strength of moreDays, there is always more than one way to get closer to your goals. Think of strenuous days, what could you do on such a day? Maybe, sports is out of reach, but you could go for a nice walk and sleep early.

Scales

With scales you could track your weight, muscles, time for 5 km or any other number based meassure. Or you could rate your mood/sleep quality, whatever you like.

Challenges

What do you want to focus on, the next week, month, until X-mas? Define your challenges in a very flexibel manner. You may focus on goals, special acitivities or a scale.

Diagrams

You may enjoy looking at your last days and weeks. Did you reach 100%% mostly? Which goal works well? Which activity?

Journal

The journal is part of the positive thinking psychology or a nice diary, however you like. Give it a try. Just search for 5 minute journal or read this article: https://www.intelligentchange.com/blogs/news/the-five-minute-journal-questions Think every day of a picture you like to take to remember this special day.

Make more days to your days. Follow your goals, remember your days. No ads, no registration, your data on your mobile.
We start with an initial set of goals and activities to reach those goals, edit/delete/add them as you like in the tools section of your bottom navigation.
In the menu you will find many ways to adapt and analyse your data, give it a try :) only what feels easy and light may be done daily …
Define your own goals. How do you want to be? What belongs to a balanced day? With the activities you define different ways to reach these goals.
For your goals you define how many points you need to reach them. Points are gained through activities. The points correspond to the weight the goals has for you. Do not start too enthusiastic…

Activities are the way to reach your goals, each day. There is always more than one way to reach a goal. That\'s the strength of moreDays :) e.g. for your goal fit you may define activities like sports (when you feel powerful) or a walk, yoga (for a strenuous day), i.e. different combinations of your activities make your goal. Think of your days and define realistic activities for each goal.
Everything possible to measure with numbers could be a scale, e.g. weight, sleep quality or time, … just give it a name and enter the values whenever you want and have a look at the charts.
Add scale values or track the just finished activity.
Tap shows you the related activities for the given goals, start collecting points :)
These are your running challenges. Select tools to manage them.

Here you may define and adapt your goals, scales and settings. You will find several lists like the list of entries and trophies -- swiping an entry will delete it. You may find additional tipps and help. Use the settings to let the app use your name or define how to start the app.
Adapt the suggested goals, activities and scales to your needs, i.e. delete some goals, more than 4 are difficult to manage ;)

Define an activity to reach this goal, e.g. for the goal to become fit you could define activities like sports, walk. There should be more than one way to reach this goal, what can you do on easy what on strenuous days?
The points may mirror, how difficult it is for you or how much time it takes. Some great activities like a great hiking tour will fill the day and hence should get the sum of all goals as points.
